study.question: Does the useful action information in stopped target-match summaries require block-specific click-group action composition, or are click-position incidence and whole-visible-history click-group means sufficient? Does that coarsening depend on task-specific versus shared residual routing?
study.hypothesis: Observation: blockwise true-click mean cells g1-r0044-match_mean_click_task/shared achieved click AUC0.6659877681/0.6648205670, versus shifted-group means0.6639141766/0.6620890559. Complement-only true-click cells in round45 fell to0.6642468841/0.6617614283, whereas shifted complements reached0.6660166195/0.6642876718. The norm-preserving residual reflections in round46 gave true-minus-shifted differences -0.0002765661(task) and +0.0001227577(shared), so they did not reproduce the projection advantage consistently. None beats the unchanged joint reference0.6667535475; auxiliary-task degradation relative to DIN and the joint reference must remain visible. These are single-seed validation observations, not independent replications. Mechanism hypothesis: much of the utility of the match-action summaries is carried by where historical click membership aligns with target matches, together with each sample's overall click/nonclick action composition; within-group temporal changes of that composition may be dispensable. Replace block-conditioned averages by history-conditioned averages without adding input information. This tests a lossy representation and temporal-composition sufficiency in this consumer, not total feedback indispensability. Original action pools, ordinal action summaries and historical masks continue to convey action information.

nearest_work.difference: Direct local reference is the existing blockwise click-stratum action-mean projection crossed with shared/task residual routing and shifted membership. Change only the averaging scope from a10-event block to the same sample's entire visible100-event history; keep shifted membership generated by the same blockwise count-preserving operator. Source implementation is inherited through the available round46 module; block parity remains to be tensor-certified.

Read archived exact-version primary section4.3 lines250-283, text SHA25683fb9eeca31e2fa3c557b6f08b893ad0018cefb33da6e00952136b9ce17e607e. Inherit target-conditioned unnormalized local activation as a fixed component. This experiment changes only a downstream historical-action summary representation in the four-task adaptation; it neither reproduces original DIN exactly nor claims a new attention method.

Read pinned benchmark forward123-169 and blocks204-219 at commit90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d. Task-mask-conditioned history hubs are relevant nearest work, but this study adds no token hubs or repeated aggregation/broadcast. It performs a parameter-free averaging-scope intervention within an existing residual architecture. The original paper paper:infnet is provenance/link-only under current granted access, so original-method priority and equivalence remain unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Add summary_projection_scope=history with FP32 averaging over the two valid click/nonclick groups of the full supplied history. All four new variants use this operator and cross partition(click versus the inherited blockwise shifted click vector) with residual routing(task versus shared). Only stopped action coordinates in match-summary rows0/4 select the transformed stream; every other consumer stays inherited. The existing block helper remains accessible through summary_projection_scope=block for host parity certification against the four round44 receipts. History means preserve global sample/group sums in exact arithmetic and remove within-group temporal composition variation, but do not preserve per-block sums, energy or effective summary rank. No novelty claim is made.
predictions: Predeclare a descriptive retention margin of0.0005 click AUC: history-mean true-click task/shared cells should each lie within0.0005 below their corresponding round44 block-mean true-click reference if local action composition is dispensable. This margin is a practical decision rule, not a confidence bound or noninferiority test.

Within new history-mean cells, true click membership should exceed shifted membership under each routing if click-position semantics remain useful beyond global action composition. Shifted membership preserves per-block counts and therefore global group cardinality; it does not preserve group-specific action contents.

Predeclare for scope s: D_s=(AUC_s,click,task-AUC_s,shift,task)-(AUC_s,click,shared-AUC_s,shift,shared). Compute D_history, D_block using all four round44 controls, and D_history-D_block; report signed values without assuming task-specific routing strengthens action utility. A main routing gain alone does not establish interaction.

Host checks should find no added parameters/buffers/RNG and should reproduce block-scope bridge predictions, source gradients and normalization updates within declared BF16 tolerance at matching weights. For the new helper, test group sums, idempotence, nested projection against block means, constant-within-group values and invalid-position invariance on valid outputs, plus empty/singleton/holey-mask cases.

Report full-population validation click AUC/logloss, all four task AUC/logloss and auxiliary mean, parameter counts, allocated GPU and wall time, examples processed, peak memory, inference throughput and p50/p95 batch latency. Retain predeclared history-length slices with sample/positive/negative counts; further composition slices are exploratory and require host-authorized masks/data only.
falsifiers: A true-click history-mean drop exceeding0.0005 relative to matched block means weakens whole-history conditional-mean sufficiency; it does not refute all click-conditioned models or feedback utility.

No true-versus-shifted advantage under either routing weakens the claim that retained click-position semantics explain utility after temporal coarsening. An inconsistent sign or unstable interaction leaves task-conditioning dependence unresolved.

A loss explained by variance/effective-rank changes or optimization, or failure to repeat in an authorized paired-seed follow-up, weakens a temporal-information explanation. Even successful retention cannot prove exclusive reliance on click masks, because conditional centroids still encode other actions and ordinary consumers remain unchanged.

Failure of block-scope parity, shape/masking/finite-gradient checks, global group-sum preservation or parameter/RNG equality invalidates the contrast until corrected. Do not score a broken implementation or silently change the frozen inputs/protocol.

Any gain confined to click with degraded auxiliary labels is not a uniform multi-task gain. Do not replace the stronger incumbent based on a weaker mechanism probe or declare new held-out performance.
alternative_explanations: Averaging changes activation variance, temporal information and effective input rank despite equal learned parameter counts; no norm or active-rank matching is claimed
Single fixed-seed training trajectories and adaptively selected validation contrasts do not establish significance or replicated mechanism support
Prior block controls are imported own-arm receipts; same-config block-scope parity must be certified by host before treating cross-round scope contrasts as matched

Full-history averaging intentionally allows sharing among valid events of the same sample and declared click group across blocks; this is a derived representation of the frozen visible prefix, not a point-in-time feedback guarantee

Block-level action mixtures could encode local item composition or rare auxiliary actions, while history averaging also reduces sampling noise; performance can reflect this bias/variance tradeoff rather than a unique semantic mechanism.
Conditional centroids remain learned embedding combinations and can encode nonclick feedback composition. Retaining quality does not establish that a binary click indicator alone is sufficient.

Match-summary coefficients center within each block, so global block constants vanish in exact arithmetic. Under history click-group means, the action summaries primarily combine target-match/click alignment with a sample-specific centroid contrast. FP32 projection and inherited BF16 contractions only approximate this identity.

The inherited official_offline visibility may include delayed feedback that was immature at impression time; conclusions apply only to the frozen offline benchmark. Auxiliary labels are user/category/brand24h matches, not advertisement-specific conversion attribution.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: Resolved run://r-001: remaining88,423.76 research-wall seconds at entry; frozen estimated unit481.3476s, validation75.2246s and per-trial cap1203.3690s. Relevant round44-46 measured whole-trial wall costs386.14-398.55s. Four new full-protocol variants estimated1925.39s total using the conservative unit estimate; worst four trial caps4813.48s. Preparation, source reads, static checks, failed metadata resolution/check attempts, host tensor checks, failures and retries all consume the existing budget. The current phase authorizes proposal/source checks only, not training.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve at least12,000s for necessary block parity certification/replacement controls and authorized paired-seed repetitions of both semantic partitions and routes. Existing same-seed matches are controls, not independent repetitions. Do not set a forbidden training-seed override in candidate config. Resolve a scale/rank concern before claiming temporal-information causality. If block-source parity cannot be established, budget and submit fresh block controls before interpreting scope effects.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve at least16,000s for freezing selected sources/configs/checkpoints, closest reference/control suite and authorized final paired-seed/closed assessment jobs. This proposal does not request withheld scoring; withheld outcomes must remain in the closed archive and cannot update open research memory.
cost_plan.stop_rule: No local training/installations/other agents. Stop on hard deadline, integrity failure, user stop, or when no useful admissible full contrast fits. Do not launch a further study if remaining budget minus its full worst-case cost and necessary certification would erode the28,000s combined attribution/assessment reserve. Honor host trial caps and ledger; never rerun an unknown-state trial automatically. If tensor prerequisites fail, retain the charged failure and correct the implementation in a subsequent authorized proposal.
